name: Saffron Bedroom Studio
description: Bedroom specialist. Discount warehouse: some of the lowest prices in town, plain finishes, no frills. We carry wardrobes, bed frames.
skill_description: We sell wardrobes, bed frames, and nothing else. Describe the piece you need in your own words (use, size, material, capacity) and we offer a matching item from our range with a price. Then send your offer as a number; we answer with a counteroffer or close the sale with a receipt.
